tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje lus kyi rnam par bzhag

pa'i spyi don bstan pa'i rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ / na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ lus lam mchog gis lus kyis skyon kun sbyangs// lus med dpung bcom lus kyi mchog brnyes nas/ /lus can kun la lus kyi lam ston der/ /lus sogs btud nas lus kyi rang bzhin bshad/ / gnyis pa nang dus 'khor rdo rje lus kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la/ lus kyi rang bzhin shes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par gtan la dbab pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dpal sambu ṭi'i rgyud las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*| |bzhi stong gi ni cho ga yis/ / lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas/ /de dag thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ces sogs dang*/ sgrub le'i nyis brgya par/ mi rnams kyis ni stong pa nyid de bzung nas stong par blta yang gang phyir 'gyur med dang bral ba/ des na gtso bos gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba 'di ni sngags kyi theg par bstan/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lus khyad par can gyi bdag rkyen las ma skyes pa'i ye shes ji tsam bsgoms kyang 'tshang rgya bar mi nus shing*/ lus kyi ye shes khyad par can skye ba la lus kyi gnas khyad par can la gnad du bsnun nas bsgom dgos la/ de la lus khyad par can rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin legs par shes dgos shing*/ mdo sde'i phyogs nas lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi skabs su/ lus la mi gtsang ba'i rdzas so gnyis 'dus tshul rgyas pa dang*/ dga' bo mngal 'jug dang*/ mngal gnas kyi mdor/ lus kyi rus pa dang tshigs dang*/ rtsa'i dbye ba sogs bshad kyang*/ nang gi rtsa 'khor dang khams kyi gnas khyad par can la sogs pa cung zad kyang bshad pa med la/ bya spyod kyi mer gnas bsam gtan la sogs pa'i skabs su/ gnas khyad par can cung zad dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi snying ga'i bdag 'jug la sogs par de bas ches gsal ba dang*/ 'dus pa bde mchog kyai rdor sogs su je gsal dang*/

khyad par 'di nyid du ches shin tu gsal shing rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir na/ mdo sde'i phyogs la sems sbyong ba'i theg pa dang*/ rgyud sde'i phyogs la lus sbyong ba'i theg pa zhes bya bar rigs shing*/ khyad par nang le bshad pa'i dgos pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam thun mong min pa rnams bsgom pa'i gnad shes pa dang*/ rdo rje'i lus la rnyed dka' don che'i bsam pa dang brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i ched yin gyi/ gang dag phyi 'jig rten khams dang*/ chos mthun shes pa tsam dang*/ 'jig rten drang don yin pa'i dgongs gzhi shes pa'i ched yin no zhes smra ba de dag ni rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di la skur ba 'debs par zad do/ /'o na lus la brten pa'i lam gtso bor byed pa ni/ lus kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis// mdud pa 'jig par gcer bu 'tshal/ khyod ni sems kyi dka' thub kyis// mdud pa 'jig par bzhed pa lags/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sems ni chos kyi gtso bo legs par gsungs/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na| de dag ni mdo phyogs kyi lung yin la/ de ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ni| gcer bu pa lta bu/ lus kyi phyi rol rags pa 'di la/ khrus dang gtsang sbra zas spyod sogs dka' thub byas pas grol bar 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ lus rags pa tsam sbyangs kyang grol mi nus pa la dgongs la/ 'dir lus rags pa'ang rten du dgos mod kyi/ de la brten pa'i lus khyad par can sbyong bar 'dod pas nyes pa med do/ /des na slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /thos pa'i pha rol son gyur kyang*/ /bdag byin brlabs las phyir bltas pas/ de yi de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du ma bsnun na/ de kho na nyid rdzogs par mi rtogs par gsungs pa mang ngo*| |'di yang lus la gnad du bsnun na rlung 'du sla zhing*/ de gnyis snang nub sla ba lta bu'i sgo nas de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa myur bul tsam du 'dod pa ltar ma yin gyi/

tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi mthar thug mnar med kyi lus shes yin pa bzhin du bde ba'i mthar thug khams drug ldan gyi lus khyad par can la brten pa'i lhan skyes kyi lus shes yin la/ de rtog med yin pas gnyis snang nub tshabs che ba dang*/ nub yun ring ba dang*/ rten thig le mi g.yo bar song na de las mi g.yo ba la sogs pa'i stobs kyis des de kho na nyid rtogs tshul ye shes rkyang pa la mi srid pa'i cha nas yin par 'dod de rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /dbang shes kha phyir bltas yin pas ngo bo nyid kyi rnam g.yeng du bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ de ni phyi rol gyi reg bya sogs kyi yul can la dgongs la/ 'di ni nang reg khyad par gyi yul can yin pas shin tu'ang rigs so/ /de ltar na nang lus kyi gnas tshul shes pa'i phyir du rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul ston pa'i le'u 'di dang*/ 'di yi cha lag tu gyur pa rnams la nan tan gyi bslab par rigs so/ / gnyis pa la lus spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ mngal skyes kyi lus bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la/ khams kyi dang*/ gnas kyi dang*/ phyi nang gi sgo nas bzhag pa'o| |dang po ni/ spyir nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kyi khams drug las/ nam mkha' ni sgra gcig pu'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ nam mkha' yon tan gcig ldan zhes bya la/ rlung la sgra dang reg pa me la de gnyis dang ro/ chu la de gsum dang gzugs/ sa la de bzhi dang dri ste lnga'i yon tan yod pas/ sa yon tan lnga ldan zhes bya'o/ /de ltar yon tan lnga po de la zla ba'i yon tan lnga zhes bya la| rdul mun snying stobs gsum la nyi ma'i yon tan gsum zhes bya ste/ de ltar brgyad po la yon tan brgyad du bshad pa mang zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na yon tan med par bshad pas/ bem chos kyi yon tan brgyad po 'di med pa yin no/ khams drug pa ni/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i skabs kun tu ston pas rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang mtshungs pas na/

sangs rgyas su bshad pa shin tu mang ba rnams kyang ye shes kyi khams la dgongs so/ /de la 'dod pa'i khams na khams drug yon tan lnga ldan gyi lus yod la/ de ni mi dang dud 'gro yin zhing*/ dmyal ba dang 'dod lha'i khams lnga yon tan bzhi ldan/ gzugs kyi bsam gtan 'og ma gnyis khams bzhi yon tan sum ldan/ gong ma gnyis khams gsum yon tan gnyis ldan/ gzugs med khams gnyis yon tan gcig ldan no| |de yang mi dang dud 'gro la sa khams dang de'i yon tan dri yang yod pas dang*| 'dod lha la de gnyis med pas dang*/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis la/ chu dang ro yang med pas dang*/ gong ma gnyis la me dang gzugs kyang med pas dang*| gzugs med la/ rlung dang reg bya yang med par nam mkha' dang de'i yon tan sgra tsam yod la/ ye shes ni thams cad la khyab byed du yod pa yin pas na| khams gong 'og gi dbye bas lus kyi phra rags de dag tu gnas shing*/ lus phra rags kyi dbang gis 'dzag bde'i phra rags kyang de ltar gnas pas na/ 'dir 'dzag bde'am 'pho ba'i bag chags 'khor ba'i rgyur bshad pa la khams gong dang*/ dmyal ba na 'dzag bde med pas mi rigs so/ /zhes smra ba de dag gis ni/ tshul 'di la zhib tu ma bslabs par zad do/ /'o na dri sa'i yon tan sogs su smra ba 'di mu stegs bye brag pa dang mtshungs pa ma yin nam snyam na/ tha snyad sgo bstun yin gyi don shin tu mi mthun te/ de dag yon tan de rnams rtags dngos su 'dod la de dag 'dir mi rtag par 'dod pas so/ /'o na bye brag pa gzugs me'i yon tan dang ro chu'i yon tan du 'dod la/ de'ang me'i gzugs rgyang ring po nas kyang mthong ba dang*/ lce thog tu chu med na ro mi myong ba rgyu mtshan du bkod nas 'chad pa 'thad kyang*/ 'dir de gnyis go ldog pas tha snyad kyang ma mthun no snyam na/ skyon med de/ spyir me tog gi gzugs lta bu'i gzugs kyi gsal bya mtha' dag chus byed pas dang*/

ston ser ro mtha' dag smin par byed pa ni chus mi 'grub kyi/ nyi ma dang drod lta bu'i me khams kyi byed pas 'byung ba'i khams kyi byed las dang mthun gyi/ me'i gzugs rgyang ring po nas mthong ba lta bu ni me'i byed las thun mong min par mi rung ba la dgongs shing 'dir khams gsum la sbyor ba'i tshe mu stegs dang bstun nas ye ler bshad pa ni/ ro me'i yon tan du byas na bsam gtan dang po gnyis na me'i yon tan yod pas ro yod par 'dod dgos la/ de ltar na khams gong na dri ro med par mngon pa nas bshad pa dang ma mthun par 'gyur du dwogs par gsal zhing*/ ye le'i rigs dang rigs bdag gi zhal gyi skabs su'ang de ltar bshad do/ / gnyis pa ni/ spyir sems yod med kyi lus can thams cad skye gnas brgyad du sgrub ler gsungs te/ 'byung bzhi zla nyi sgra gcan dus me'i skye gnas rnams so/ /de yang ljon shing dang lhun po la sogs pa brtan pa rnams sa'i drod gsher skyes chu'i/ sgong skyes rlung gi mngal skye me'i/ nam mkha'i khams la zla nyi gnyis dang*/ ye shes la sgra gcan du sa mer phye nas klu dang lha min zla ba'i/ lha dang 'byung po nyi ma'i/ gzugs med sgra gcan gyi dmyal ba dus me'i skye gnas su bshad la/ yongs grags kyi skye gnas bzhi dang sbyor ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi skye ba rnams rdzus skyes chen po ro'i skye ba dang*/ sa'i skye ba rnams kyang rdzus skyes brtan pa'i skye gnas su khams ler bshad pa'i don ni rgyas par bshad zin pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa ni/ phyi rol gyi yan lag nying lag dang mdog dbyibs/ gzugs sgra sogs ni lus rags pa yin la/ nang gi rtsa phra rags rnams ni phra ba dang*/ khams dkar dmar dang*/ rlung phra mo sogs ni shin tu phra ba dang*/ gzhom med kyi rtsa rlung thig le rnams ni ches shin tu phra ba yin no/ /zhes bya ste/ de ltar phyi nang gi bzhag pa'i phra rags dang*/

gzhan gnyis la ni sa chu'i khams gnyis rags pa dang*/ me rlung gnyis phra ba dang*/ nam mkha' shin tu phra ba dang*/ ye shes ches shin tu phra ba'i lus zhes bya bar grub la/ gzhi'i ye shes kyi khams 'dis ni/ gzhi la bde chen dang stong gzugs yod par bstan te/ le'u 'di'i tshigs bcad gsum pa'i 'grel par/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen pos khams gsum thams cad bdag nyid la gnas par gsungs pa dang*| stong pa la ni ye shes rnam par bsres zhes pa rtsa 'grel la sogs pa'i lung gis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pa yang sor sdud sogs bsgoms pa'i tshe du sogs kyi stong gzugs mthong ba rnams rgyu med du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lung de dag gis mi 'grub ste/ rnal 'byor pas shes par bya zhes sogs lam dang sbyar nas bshad pas so zhe na/ lam bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhi gtan la 'bebs kyi skabs su 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin pas so/ /bsgom pa'i stobs kyis zhes pa gcig 'dir bshad pa ni/ bsgoms stobs kyis gsal bar 'byung ba de dper bstan pa'i ched du gsungs pa yin gyi| gzhan du na gzhi gtan 'bebs kyi skabs ma yin par gsal bas gnod la| tshigs bcad gsum pa 'di ye shes le'ur 'chad par gsungs pa ltar der rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs na bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis zhes pa yang med pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la/ lus la sna tshogs 'byung ba mdor bstan/ de'i skye gnas 'jig chos rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyi lus la sngar bshad pa'i phyi'i 'jig rten gyi snod bcud sna tshogs tshang la/ tshang tshul yang khams dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas tshang tshul 'og tu ston cing*/ 'dir rang rang yi ge'i sgo nas tshang tshul gsungs te/ phyi rol gyi sa chu me rlung ni/ nang gi lte snying mgrin spyi yin la| yi ge so mchu rkan spyi bo rnams las byung ba'i sde pa rnams kyis shes par bya la|

de bzhin du phyi'i rdo rje glog dang lha gzhu 'ja' tshon ni dus me'i rtsa dang bshang lam gyi rtsa yin la/ ṛ dang l̥ yig gis so/ /phyi'i rlung bcu ni snying ga'i rtsa bcu la gnas pa'i rlung bcu ste/ i yig sogs kyis so/ /phyi rol na rlung bcu yod par ni ye shes le'u'i tshigs bcad brgya re lnga pa'i 'grel par gsungs la/ snod mi 'jig par 'dzin pa srog 'dzin dang*/ chu thur du 'ded pa thur sel dang*/ me dang shing sogs gyen du bskyod pa gyen rgyu dang*/ cha mnyam par gnas pa mnyam gnas sogs su bzhag par bu ston rin po ches gsung ngo*| |khyim bcu gnyis sam zhag sum brgya drug cu ni/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi rtsa la gsal byed sum cu la dbyangs bcu gnyis zhugs pas dang*/ zla ba ni dkar cha la thig le dang nyi ma ni dmar cha la tsheg drag dang*/ sgra gcan ni rnam shes la gzhom med kyi ha dang*/ lhun po ni lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar la ming yig dang po me ru'i srog e yig gis dang*/ gdeng can dang mi dang lha rnams kyi gnas ni bla ma dam pas dpral mgrin snying ka zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yang na lus kyi smad dang bar dang stod kyi cha rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dang*/ 'khyog po ni/ khyim la yon por rgyu ba'i gza' bcu po rnams te/ snying ga'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa bcu la sngar zung bdun du brjod pa'i sa bon rnams kyis dang*/ skar ma ni/ mgrin pa'i rtsa so gnyis las nyer brgyad la sbyor dgos par gsal la/ yi ge ma bshad kyang gza'i yi ge rnams kyis ston par bcas zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis shes so/ /'pho ba dang zla ba bcu gnyis ni gsal byed sde pa drug thung ring du phye bas dang*/ phyogs nyer bzhi ni de'i phyed kyi dang*/ nyin mtshan sum brgya drug cu ni sde pa drug la dbyangs thung ngu drug dang ring po drug gis bsgyur bas shes par bya la| nang gi 'pho ba bcu gnyis ni/ gsal byed zla ba drug kyang de nyid la bya zhing phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/

rlung dgu brgya pa re dang*/ zhag ni/ rlung drug cu pa re la byed dgos par gsal lo/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum phyogs gcig tu sbyar ba ni/ ye shes le'u'i re gcig pa sogs kyis bshad de/ skra dang ba spu/ phyi'i nam mkha' dang*/ gzhan gyi ka sde dang rab dga'/ sha dang pags pa/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ tsa sde dang dri ma med pa/ khrag phra rags gnyis/ me'i dkyil 'khor/ ṭa sde 'od byed rdul dang dri chu chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ pa sde dang 'od 'phro/ rkang dang rus pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ta sde dang sbyang dka'/ rtsa dang rlung bcu brtan pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ sa sde dang mngon du gyur pa dung can ma sgra gcan gyi mjug ma ni/ g.yo ba'i 'jig rten dang*/ la wa ra ya ha dang*/ ring du song ba/ a ba dhū tī ni/ sgra gcan dang*/ al o ar e a dang mi g.yo ba/ ro ma ni/ nyi ma dang*/ a i ṛ u l̥ dang legs blo/ rkyang ma ni zla ba dang haḥ.aṃ/ chos kyi sprin rnams dang sbyar nas gsungs pa'i mthar/ lus las ma gtogs gang zhig khyab byed thar pa ster ba'i sangs rgyas gzhan ni 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gong rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi skabs su bshad zin pa ltar rdo rje'i lus la shin tu gus par bya ste/ 'di dag ni dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos skor mang du bshad pa thams cad kyang zhar la lhag dang bcas pa 'grub pa'i bshad pa'o/ /de ltar khams bcu'i nang nas dang po lnga so sor bgrangs te/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams dang*/ phyi ma gcig tu bgrangs nas ye shes kyi khams zhes gcig tu byas pas khams drug po 'di ni mngal skyes kyi lus 'di la 'grub la/ de yang pha ma dang rang gis ro drug zos shing 'thung pa dag gi rkyen gyis ma grub pa sgrub pa dang*/ grub zin gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ro drug ni lan tshwa sa| mngar ba chu/ tsha ba me/ kha ba rlung*/ bska ba nam mkha'/ skyur ba ye shes kyi khams rnams so// ro drug rnams kyang nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ste 'byung ba lnga las grub pa las/

'byung ba'i tshogs kyang sngar le'u dang po'i tshigs bcad bzhi par brjod pa'i nam mkha'i ming can stong pa'i rdul las 'byung la/ stong pa de la ye shes kyi ming can sems can rnams kyi lus la khyab byed du gnas pa'i rnam shes bsres pa 'di ni sems can thams cad la khyab par gnas pas bar do dang gzugs med kyi sems can yang 'di dang ldan no/ /'di ni kun rdzob pa'i tshul gyis gnas par 'di'i 'grel par gsungs nas/ yang stong pa la ni ye shes rnam par bsres pa ro mnyam 'gyur med rtag par rtsa bar gsungs pa 'di ni| gtso bor bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis grub pa'i stong gzugs bzung bya 'dzin byed kyi sems la dgongs pa ste/ 'di la ro mnyam dang 'gyur med dang brtag pa'i don rdzogs par tshang bas so snyam du dgongs so/ /de yang rtag pa'i don ni sgrib bral du gsungs so/ /de yang rang gi ngo bo sgrib pa med pa'ang 'pho ba'i sgrib pa med pa la dgongs shing*/ ro mnyam dbyer med la 'dir ngos 'dzin ma mdzad kyang gnas skabs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin/ bzung bya 'dzin byed ngo bo gcig pa dang*/ rgyun 'gyur mi srid pa la dgongs so/ /'di dag gis ni gzhi la stong gzugs yul can dang bcas pa yod par bstan te/ gzhi la med pa lam stobs kho nas byung na glo bur bar song bas 'gyur bcas dang rgyun mi rtag par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'byung bas ro drug gis khams drug bskyed tshul la yang ma'i padmar gnas pa'i khu rdul rnam shes gsum 'dus pa'i gong bu de la ma'i sa sogs 'byung ba rnams kyis sra ba dang sdud pa dang smin pa dang 'phel ba dang 'phel ba'i go skabs sbyin par byed la/ sa bon kho rang gi steng gi sa sogs lngas kyang bya ba de dag byas nas mthar lha khyab 'jug gi gnas skabs bcu bskyed par gsungs so/ /'dir sa bon rang la mngal grub tsam nas rlung bcu yod par gsungs pa dang*/ 'og nas zla ba bdun gyi bar du rlung bcu mi 'grub par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/

'dir nang gi phyi'i rlung gis lus mi 'jig par 'dzin pa sogs la dgongs la 'og nas rtsa nang du 'grub pa'i nang gi rlung la dgongs pas mi 'gal lo/ /'dir khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu ni gnas skabs bcu la sbyar ba ste/ de'ang dga' bo mngal gnas dang tshe'i mtha'i mdo las btsas pa'i gnas skabs rkyang pa la/ gnas skabs bcu sbyar ba lta bu yang ma yin/ mngon pa las mngal gyi lnga dang btsas pa'i lnga ste bcu gsungs pa lta bu yang ma yin pa zhig 'dir gsungs te/ de yang sbyar bya 'jug pa bcu tshangs pa 'am drang srong gdug pa can gyis byis pa rnams bslu ba'i don du bkod par gsungs pa rnams ni lha chen khyab 'jug gis sngon rig byed bzhi po rgya mtshor shor ba na/ nya ru sprul nas bton te lha rnams la sbyin pas drin che/ de bzhin du sa 'dzin lag pa chen pos sa gzhi 'degs ma nus pas rus sbal du sprul nas btegs sa gzhi rgya mtshor shor ba phag tu sprul nas bton/ dgra ngan dang skya seng g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe/ drang srong ya mad agni'i bu drang srong rā ma ṇar skyes nas srid sgrub la sogs pa'i rgyal rigs bye ba phrag brgya bsad/ rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu rgyal rigs rā ma ṇar skyes nas srin po btul/ nag par skyes nas chu bo ya mu na la chu drangs nas chu bran thams cad bzos/ sa thams cad thong gshol gyis rlog nas 'bru btab/ mi'i seng ger skyes nas lha min gyi rgyal po 'gro skyong gser can bsad/ mi'u thung du sprul nas lha min gyi rgyal po stobs ldan g.yo sgyus bslus/ sangs rgyas su sprul nas dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis bsad pa'i sgrib sbyong gi chos bstan/ bram ze grags pa'i bur skyes nas rigs bzhi po thams cad bram ze'i rigs ldan du byas zhes lha las phul byung 'grel par bshad de/ tshigs bcad du byas na/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang*// rā ma gnyis dang nag po dang*/
/mi yi seng ge mi'u thung*/ /sangs rgyas rigs ldan de ltar bcu/ /nya ru sprul nas rig byed bton/ /rus sbal gzugs kyis 'jig rten bteg/

phag rgod mche bas sa gzhi bton/ /drang srong rā mas rgyal rigs bsad/ /rgyal rigs rā mas srin po btul/ /nag pos chu drangs 'bru rnams btab/ /mi yi seng ges gser can bsad/ /mi'u thung gis stobs ldan bslus| |sangs rgyas sprul nas sgrib sbyong bstan/ /grags pas rigs kun bram zer byas/ /zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bcu po de'i tha snyad sgo bstun pa'i phyir du gnas skabs bcu la sgro btags bzhi yod pas sbyar la/ don ni mchog mi 'gyur du rgyas par 'gog par mdzad do/ /sbyor tshul yang*/ mngal gyi gnas skabs kyi zla ba dang po gnyis la nya dang dbyibs mthun la/ de nas zla ba gnyis la 'bur po lnga cung zad dod pas rus sbal/ de nas zla ba lnga dang drug la sogs pa la phag pa'i dbyibs su gnas pas te mngal la gsum/ btsas pa'i skabs ni mi'i seng ge ste/ rlung gi nus pas rtsal chen pos skye gnas kyi sgo 'byed pas so/ /de nas byis pa'i gnas skabs la gnyis te/ so ma skyes kyi bar du mi'u thung ste dbyibs mthun pas sa/ so skyes nas lhung ba'i bar la dpras st+wa rā ṇa rgyal rigs bsad pa dang 'dra bar mi bdag gnyis btung bar byed pas so/ /gzhon nu la gcig ste| so phyi ma skyes nas lo bcu drug gi bar du lha rā ma ṇa ste so gnyis pa rnams ltung bar byed pas so/ /lang tsho la gcig ste/ lo bcu drug nas skra dkar skyes kyi bar la nag pa ste lus rtsal sems rtsal 'dzom pas g.yo sgyu'i las byed pas so| |lha rā ma ṇa dang nag pa 'di gnyis la rgyas pa dang po dang gnyis pa zhes bshad do/ /rgan po la gcig ste/ skra dkar nas 'chi ba'i bar la sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ bud med la cher mi sbyor bas tshangs par spyod pa dang lus sems kyi rtsal nyams pas zhi bar gnas pas so/ /'chi khar rigs ldan te/ khams rags pa thams cad rnam shes kyi khams gcig la sdud pas so/ / gnyis pa la/ mngal chags nas skye tshul/

skyes pa 'phel tshul/ 'phel nas gnas tshul/ gnas pa 'jig tshul/ 'jig pa bsrung tshul lo/ / dang po la/ mngal 'grub tshul/ mdor bstan/ bden pa dang sbyar nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir pha ma'i khu khrag gi rnam 'gyur las/ rdo rje snying 'grel ltar na nang gi skye bdun 'grub ste/ bcud dang*/ khrag dang*/ sha dang*/ pags pa dang*| rtsa dang*/ rus pa dang rkang rnams so/ /'grel chen ltar na nang gi mdzod drug ste/ khu ba las ni rkang dang rus pa rgyus pa/ /rdul las pags pa khrag dang sha rnams te/ /mdzod drug po 'di ni sdom 'byung dang sambu ṭir yang 'di ji bzhin du bshad do/ /bye brag tu ni mngal bzung ba'i zla ba dang po la khu khrag 'dres pa bdud rtsi lnga'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur te/ khu ba la rkang dang dri chu gnyis/ khrag la bshang ba ste de rnams so sor pha ma las thob bo/ /'o na bshang gci zla ba brgyad pa'i bar du mi 'byung bar bshad pa ci zhe na/ phra rags kyi khyad par yin cing*| snga ma pha ma'i dang phyi ma rang gi yin gsungs so/ /zla ba gnyis pa la nya'i rnam pa gsal por 'gyur zhing*/ zla stod la snying ga'i rtsa brgyad dang smad la lte ba'i rtsa rnams skra rtse ltar phra ba grub bo/ /zla ba gsum pa la yan lag gi 'bur po lnga cung zad dod pa dang*/ bzhi pa la mnyam por dod cing rtsa phra mo rnams mgrin dpral gsang ba'i rtsa phra mo'ang 'grub bo/ /zla ba de gnyis rus sbal gyi dbyibs so/ /zla ba lnga pa la sha dang khrag so sor 'byed cing skye mched rnams rtsom pa dang*/ rus pa sum brgya drug cur so sor gyes te/ dga' bo mngal gnas las/ mgo thod rus pa dgu 'dus shing*/ /'gram pa'i rus pa gnyis 'brel te/ /so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de yi rtsa ba de bzhin no/ /rna rtsa gnya' ba'i rus pa dang*/ /rkan dang sna yi rus pa dang*/ /brang dang mid pa'i rus pa ni// bsdus na rus pa nyi shu yod/ /mig la rus pa bzhi yod de/

/phrag pa byin pa zung gnyis yod/ /lag pa byin pa sor mo rnams/ /bsdus na rus pa lnga bcu yod// ltag rgyab rus pa brgyad yod de/ /sgal tshigs la ni sum cu gnyis/ /'di dag kun la rtsa yod pas/ /'di yi grangs kyi cha bzhi 'gyur/ /rtsib logs g.yas pa'i rus pa ni/ /phan tshun 'brel ba bcu gsum yod/ /rtsib logs g.yon 'brel skye ba ni/ /rus pa dag ni bcu gsum yod/ /rus pa'i lu gu rgyud 'di dag |phan tshun du ni gsum gsum 'brel/ /gnyis gnyis dag ni tshigs ldan te| |lhag ma dag ni 'brel ba med/ /g.yas g.yon brla ni gnyis po la// bsdus na rus pa lnga bcu yod/ /lus nang 'brel pa'i rus pa ni/ /bsdus na sum brgya drug cu yod/ /ces gsungs pa rnams so/ /de bzhin du tshigs sum brgya drug cu yang 'grub par gsungs la/ sgrub ler tshigs sum brgya drug cu gsungs pa ni dus 'khor gyi phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sor mo'i tshigs grangs yin la 'di ni rus pa sum brgya drug cu po sbrel pa'i tshig yin pas gcig tu mi bzung ngo*| |zla ba drug pa la sha khrag rags pa dang tshor ba bde sdug 'byung zhing sngon gnas rjes su dran pa lta bu 'byung ngo*/ /zla ba bdun pa la smin ma spu skra bug pa rkang lce dang lce'i rnam shes dang rtsa nang gi rlung phra mo sogs 'byung*/ /zla ba brgyad pa la bshang gci phra mo 'byung*/ zla ba dang po'i khu khrag la bshang gci tshang bar bshad pa phra mo'i phra mo dwangs ma la bya/ zla ba dgu pa dang kha cig la bcu pa/ kha cig la bcu gcig pa'am bcu gnyis pa'i mthar btsa' ba'i dus su skye gnas kyis btsir ba'i sdug bsngal drag po 'byung ngo*/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i rtsa phra mo rlung gi rten byed par bshad pa ni/ 'chad 'gyur gyi zla ba bdun pa nas rgyu ba'i rlung gi rten byed pa la dgongs/ mngal zla gnyis pa'i 'go zug tsam pa'i nyin zhag nas bzung ste rtsa 'khor rnams kyi grangs la mi gtogs pa'i rtsa phra mo zhag re la nyis brgya re chags la de nas bgrangs pa'i mngal gyi bar dang*/

mngal thon nas kyang rung ste zhag sum brgya drug cu la rtsa bdun khri nyis stong rdzogs par 'chags so/ /yang mngal du ji srid gnas pa'i bar la mngon shes lnga dang ldan zhes bshad pa ni/ dus 'khor ba 'di so skye la mngon shes med par 'dod pa dang*| mngal du mngon shes yod pa 'gal zhe na/ so skye la med pa ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i so skye la sngags kyi mngon shes lnga med pa la dgongs la mngal na yod par bshad pa ni mngal gyi ring la rlung dbu ma nas kyang mi rgyu bas gnas par mngon shes cha mthun yod pa la dgongs pas skyon med do/ / mngal gyi gnas skabs la mngon byang bzhi yang tshang bar bshad de/ dang por bde rgyal ba skad cig gcig 'bur po lnga dod rnam pa lnga/ sor mo nyi shu dod pa rnam pa nyi shu/ phyir rtsa sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa'o/ /phag pa'i gnas skabs btsa' kha ba la sbyor na| bdun pa nas skye ba'i nyin zhag gi bar du mi'i seng ge la rab tu skye zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ bar du'o zhes pa'i rdzogs tshig chad pa'i 'gyur skyon yin gyi| gzhan du na 'og tu zla ba dgu pa rdzogs par gyur pa'am/ kha cig tu bcu pa'am bcu gcig pa'am bcu gnyis pa la phag gi dngos po'i mjug tu mngal drag por 'gyur zhes pa dang 'gal lo/ /'o na khyod kyis 'dir bshad pa'i zla grangs la rtsa chags tshul dang 'og gi sgrub ler sbyang gzhi dang sbyar ba'i skabs ma mthun pas skyon yod do zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'dir rtsa rnams phra mo 'grub pa'i dbang du byas la| sgrub ler rags pa'i 'grub dus dang sbyar bas so/ / gnyis pa la sdug bden dang sbyar ba ni/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gzod par dka' ba rnams bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i sgyu mas rmongs par byas pa'i yang dang yang du 'khor zhing myong bar gsungs pas/ lugs 'di la bdag 'dzin las nyon gyi rtsa bar mi 'dod do zhes smra ba rnams bkag go /lam bden dang sbyor ba ni/

mir skye ba dang dge sdig la blang dor gyi blo skye ba dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la gus pa dang*/ rgyud sde la 'jug pa dang*/ bde chen la 'jug pa rnams je dkar bstan pa'i sgo nas lam gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa dang*/ khyad par dbang bzhi pa'i lam du gsungs shing phar phyin theg pa dang rgyu 'bras su bstan pas lam thun mong pas rgyud sbyang dgos pa dang*/ sngags kyi yang rim gnyis rim can du dgos par bstan to/ /'on kyang bskyed rim mthar ma phyin bar du rdzogs rim la 'jug tu mi rung ba ni mi bzhed de 'og tu 'chad do/ / kun 'byung la/ lam gyi 'bras bu dang*/ rten dang brten par dang*/ khams kyi 'gyur ba 'byung ba'i kun 'byung ngo*// dang po ni/ lam gyi 'bras bu ni sku bzhi dang*/ rdo rje bzhi yin la de mngal skyes kyi lus la tshang tshul gyi sgo nas gsungs te/ de'i dang po sku bzhi la yang ye shes kyi dbye bas lus gtso bor gyur pa mngal gyi gnas skabs/ rnam shes kyi dbye bas ngag gtso bor gyur pa btsas pa'i gnas skabs te gnyis la sku bzhi sbyar nas so sor dang*/ thun mong du sbyar ba gnyis gsungs pa'i dang por thun mong ba ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs ril po dang*/ btsas nas so skyes pa'i bar dang*/ so lhung nas yang skyes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas 'chi ba'i bar rnams la rim pa bzhin du dag pa dang*/ chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i skur tha snyad sbyar du rung ste/ rlung dbu mar gnas pas sngon gnas dran pa sogs kyi mngon shes rjes mthun pa yod pa dang*/ yul dang por rig pa sogs kyi 'du shes gsal ba dang*/ rlung gi bya ba rdzogs pas tshig gsal por smra ba dang*/ g.yo sgyu sogs kyis lus kyi bya ba du ma spro bar byed pa rnams kyi phyir ro/ /so so la gnyis kyi dang po mngal du sbyar ba ni/ mngal du khu rdul rnam shes gsum 'dus ma thag pa dang*/ zla ba lnga pa'i bar la khams dang*/

phung po lnga grub pa dang*| drug pa bdun par yul dang yul can rnams longs spyad bya spyod byed du grub pa dang*/ brgyad pa sogs la skra spu bshang gci grub nas btsa' ba rnam dag chos longs sprul te/ rdul mun snying stobs cha mnyam pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes bde ba bzhi pa la 'jug pa'i dang*/ mun pa'i dbang gis rtog med gnyid log pa dang*/ rdul gyi dbang gis yul snang rdzun pa rmi lam gyi dang*/ snying stobs kyi dbang gis yul rags pa sad pa'i gnas skabs rnams la 'jug pa'i phyir te/ de ltar mngal gyi sku bzhi po gnas skabs kyi rtog pa bzhi la bzhag pas rnam shes kyis phye bar gsungs shing*/ de la'ang rlung grogs su yod pas ye shes grogs su yod pa dang*/ ngag dang 'brel ba can zhes gsungs la/ gtso bor pha las skyes pas khu ba'i khams las grub par gsungs so/ /btsas pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyar ba ni/ btsas ma thag 'pho rlung mi rgyu ba'i mnyam rgyu ye shes kyi rlung nyi zla'i yon tan med pa nga drug bzhi cha rgyu ba dang*/ de nas so skyes kyi bar dang*/ so lhung nas skyar ma skyes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas 'chi ba'i bar rnams kyang sku bzhi ste/ nyi zla'i yon tan gyi snang ba yang med pa dang*/ 'du shes gsal zhing tshig mi gsal ba dang*/ de yang shin tu gsal ba dang*/ sgyu ma'i drwa bar snang ba'i dngos po mtha' dag rig pa dang*/ rim pa ltar dga' ba bzhi'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dga' bzhi gtso che bas 'di la ye shes su bzhag la/ de la lus grogs su yod pas rnam zhes grogs su yod pa dang*/ lus dang 'brel can zhes gsungs la/ gtso bor ma las skyes pas rdul gyi khams las grub par gsungs so/ /yang lus kyi dbye ba ni/ sa bon dang 'brel ba can dang*/ ngag gi dbye ba ni/ khrag dang 'brel ba can zhes gsungs pa'ang*/ spu la sogs pa'i khams bcu drug dang / khrag gam nyi ma'i rang bzhin 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang gtso bor 'brel bas so/

/rdo rje bzhir bzhag pa ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs dang*/ btsas ma thag pa dang*/ so skyes pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ so gnyis pa skyes pa phan chod rnams la sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rjer bzhag ste/ rim pa ltar lus rdzogs pa dang / srog 'byung ba dang*/ yul gsal bar 'dzin pa dang*/ 'pho bde rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la 'byung ba'i dang*/ tshogs pa'i rten dang brten pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyi snying po ni/ rim pa ltar me dang sa dang chu dang nam mkha' rnams yin te/ 'di'i snying po'i don ni/ de las byung ba la byed pa gang zhig rdo brdabs pa las me 'byung ba dang*/ chu bsrubs pa las sa 'byung ba dang*/ mes sros pa las chu 'byung ba dang*/ nam mkha'i khongs na rlung dang sa sogs gnas pas so/ /de'i snying po yin kyang*/ de'i rigs can ma yin te| yin na rigs de'i bya ba byed dgos pa las mes sra ba'i bya ba mi byed cing*/ yon tan dri med pa'i phyir te gzhan la'ang sbyar ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams phyi ma phyi ma la snga ma snga ma brten la/ nam mkha' ni ye shes la brten no/ /'bras gzugs kyang 'byung ba rnams ni phung po rags pa'i rten yin te/ pha ma'i 'byung ba med na mngal skyes kyi ma rig pa la sogs pa'i rten 'brel med la de med na phung po med pas so/ / 'byung ba ni rtsa dang*/ rtsa ni rlung dang*/ rlung ni sems dang*/ sems ni rang bzhin can yul gyi rang bzhin gsal ba sad rmi gnyis dang*/ rang bzhin med pa gnyid 'thug bzhi pa gnyis te/ snga ma phyi ma la brten pa dang*/ de yang gtso bo srid pa gsum gyis brgyud cing gzhom med kun tu 'gro ba gang zhes pa gzhi'i dus 'khor gzhom med kyi rlung sems la brten par gsungs so/ /'dir rlung rtsa'i rten du bshad pa dang*/ gong du ldog nas gsungs pa mi 'gal te/ gong du rtsa nang nas rlung rgyu ba dang*/ 'dir lung gis rtsa ma grub pa sgrub pa dang*/

grub zin gnas par byed pa ste rlung dang bral na rtsa mi 'grub cing 'jig pa la dgongs pas so/ / gsum pa la/ phung po drug dbang po drug nyon mongs drug las dbang drug rlung bcu/ 'khor lo bco brgyad/ sor mo nyi shu/ so so gnyis/ skra dang ba spu khams kyi 'gyur bar 'byung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes las dri gzugs ro reg sgra chos rnams 'byung*/ 'dir zhi ba ye shes las sgra dang nam mkha' las chos 'byung bar bshad pa ni 'gyur gyi skyon no|| gnyis pa ni/ lus lce mig sna rna ba yid kyi dbang po rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams ye shes kyi khams te yul reg ro gzugs dri sgra chos rnams rlung me chu sa ye shes nam mkha'i khams yin pas rim bzhin 'dzin cing thabs shes sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar khams drug dang phung po drug tshogs pa gcig tu 'grub ste/ gzugs tshor 'du shes rnam shes 'du byed ye shes kyi phung po rnams sa me chu rlung nam mkha' rnam shes rnams las grub ste/ sa sra ba bzhin du gzugs kyang phung po gzhan la bltos te sra ba bem chos yin pa dang*/ smin pa'i bya ba mes byed pa bzhin du dkar nag gi las kyang tshor ba bde sdug tu smin pa dang*| chus dngos po sdud 'byed byed pa bzhin du 'du shes kyis tha snyad 'byed sdud byed pa dang*/ rlung gis g.yo bar byed pa bzhin du 'du byed sems pas kyang rnam shes yul la g.yo bar byed pa dang*/ nam mkha' kun la khyab pa bzhin du rnam shes kyis kun la khyab cing rten byed pa dang*/ rnam shes kyis rten byed pa bzhin du ye shes kyang phung po thams cad kyi rten yin pas so/ /'dir rna ba rdo rje ste ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang*/ yid nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang*/ sna sa'i/ lce me'i/ mig chu'i/ lus rlung gi rang bzhin du bshad pa rnams ni 'grel pas de dang de'i rang bzhin can gyi yul 'dzin pas de dang de'i rang bzhin du gsungs so|

|gsum pa ni/ gti mug nga rgyal/ 'dod chags/ phrag dogazhe sdang*/ ser sna rnams rim pa bzhin/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes las 'byung la/ ser sna ye shes khams la 'gyur te zhes sogs bdun pa gnas gzhi'i sgras gsungs pa ni/ las zhes pa lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi sgra sbyar rgyu yin pas lnga pa la bdun pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te skabs gzhan du yang go bar bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan 'grel par gsal bar ma gsungs la/ bu ston/ dad 'dun spro ba med pa lta bu'i sems sra ba ni sa yin pas dang*/ chus dngos po thams cad bskyed nas mthon por byed pa ltar sems mtho bar byed pas dang*/ drod kyis gtum mo 'bar ba na chags pa skye ba dang*/ rlung gis g.yo ba ltar gzhan gyi phung tshogs la g.yo bar byed pas dang

/ 'khrug pa dang rdeg 'tshog sogs kyi go nam mkhas 'byed pa dang*/ ser sna bde tshor las 'byung gi sdug bsngal las mi 'byung la ye shes bde ba yin pas so zhes gsungs*/ bla ma dam pa dbang po reg pas sra ba'i bag chags skye la / de las gti mug gi chos sems mi gsal ba 'byung bas dang*| 'du shes la nga rgyal 'byung bas dang*/ bde tshor la chags pa skye bas dang*| rlung gi mngal du byang sems 'phangs pa la bar do'i phrag dog 'byung bas dang*| nam mkha'i khams kyi sgra mi snyan pa las zhe sdang skye bas zhes gsungs la ye shes la rgyu mtshan ma sbyar ro/ /gzugs phung blun pas dnga'adu shes rig pas dang*| tshor ba la bde sdug la phrad bral du sred pas dang*/ 'du byed sems pas gzhan gyi yon tan mi bzod pas dang*/ rnam shes gzhan la mnar sems pas dang*| ye shes snyoms par gnas pas gti mug sogs bskyed la/ phung po drug pos chu sogs su gnas pas so zhes bya'o/ bla ma dam pas/ brtag gnyis kyi/ chu ni mi bskyod gzigs kyi phyir/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs dang 'di sbyar ba ni / 'dod chags/ phrag dog gti mug gsum mthun pa tsam du zad do/ / bzhi pa na/ kha/ lag rkang pa/ bshang lam/ bha ga mchog gi dbang po rnams rlung me chu sa nam mkha' ye shes te/ 'di rnams la las dbang drug ces bya la/ 'di rnams kyi bya ba ni/ ngag smra ba/ len pa/ 'gro ba/ bshang ba 'dor ba/ dri chu 'dor ba/ khu ba 'pho ba rnams yin la/ de rnams kyi khams ni rlung me chu sa ye shes nam mkha' zhes bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan ni skabs 'dir ma gsungs so/ / lnga pa ni/ snying ga'i steng gi rtsa'i rlung srog 'dzin ni nam mkha'i khams te g.yas g.yon dbu ma nas rgyu ba gsum ga'o/ /rtsa rgyud du g.yon g.yas chu mer bshad pa ni nam mkha'i nang tshan la dgongs so/ /'og gi thur sel ni ye shes te bshang gci khu ba gsum ga'i rlung ngo*/ /rtsa rgyud du bshang gci gnyis sa chur bshad pa'ang snga ma bzhin no/

/snying kha'i shar dang shar lho'i mnyam gnas dang rus sbal rlung*/ lho dang lho nub kyi gyen rgyu dang rtsang pa me/ byang dang byang shar gyi khyab byed dang lhas byin chu/ nub dang nub byang kyi klu dang nor las rgyal sa khams par bshad pa ni phyogs kyi nges pa'i dbang gis so// skyes pa la lo bcu drug dang*/ bud med la lo bcu gnyis kyi mthar thig le g.yo bar byed pa dga' ba'i rlung dang*/ 'dzag par byed pa lhan cig skyes dga'i rlung gnyis ni rim pa ltar nam mkha'i khams dang*/ ye shes kyi khams las byung bar bshad do/ / drug pa ni/ nang gi 'khor lo drug ni/ gsang ba lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor rnams ye shes sa rlung me chu nam mkha'i khams yin la/ rkang pa'i tshigs chen drug gi g.yon pa gsum sa dang g.yas pa gsum chu| lag pa'i tshigs chen drug gi g.yas pa gsum rlung dang g.yon pa gsum me khams yin pas/ skyes bu mgo shar lho dang rkang pa nub byang du bstan nas gan rkyal du nyal ba'i lag pa gnas pa'i mkhrig ma shar gling byang ma/ gru mo dbus ma| dpung tshigs lho ma/ lag pa g.yon pa dpung tshigs lho gling shar ma/ gru mo dbus ma/ mkhrig ma nub ma/ rkang pa g.yon ma'i tshigs gsum nub gling gsum| g.yas pa'i tshigs gsum byang gling gsum du gnas par bshad do// ye shes le'ur 'di go ldog tu gsungs pa'i 'di bsam pa dang*/ ye le lus kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ / bdun pa ni/ sor mo nyi shu'i mthe bong sa/ mdzub mo chu/ gung mo me/ ming med rlung*/ mthe'u chung nam mkha' ste/ re re la mun rdul snying stobs kyi dbang gis rtsa ba dang bar pa dang rtse mo ste tshigs phreng gsum po nag dmar dkar ba'o/ /sor mo drug pa byung na ye shes kyi khams par bu ston bzhed do/ / brgyad pa ni/ so sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ ma so gnyis dang de rjes ya so gnyis gnyis spel nas skye ba rnams sa chu me rlung gi 'byung bzhi sdud rim du skye ste|

ma so g.yas pa sa dang*/ g.yon pa chu/ de rting ya so g.yas pa me dang*/ g.yon pa rlung*/ yang ma so g.yas pa me dang*/ g.yon pa rlung*/ ya so g.yas pa sa dang*/ g.yon pa chu dang*/ yang ma so g.yas pa me dang*/ g.yon pa rlung*/ ya so gnyis sa dang chu/ yang ma so nas brtsams ba'i lugs 'byung du 'byung la/ gal te ya so gnyis thog mar skyes na g.yas pa nam mkha' g.yon pa rlung*/ de nas ma so gnyis me dang chu ste snga ma las lugs ldog tu 'byung ste mdor na khams bzhi'i rang bzhin du skye la/ mche ba lhag por byung na nam mkha'i khams pa'o/ / dgu pa ni/ de bzhin du lus kyi skra dang ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi po thams cad kyang khu ba dang rdul gyi rnam 'gyur du gyur pa'i khams drug gi rang bzhin du shes par bya ste de ltar kun 'byung gi bden pas lus 'grub tshul rgyas par gsungs shing*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ni shugs la shes par bya dgos te 'dir ma gsungs so/ / gnyis pa 'phel tshul la/ 'phel ba'i rgyu dang*/ tshul dngos so/ /dang po la rten dang brten par gnas pas dang*/ thabs dang shes rab tu gnas pas 'phel tshul lo/ /dang po la 'khor lo drug dang sku bzhi/ 'khor lo drug dang rigs drug rtsa drug dang rigs drug rten dang brten par gnas pas 'phel tshul lo| | dang po ni/ nang gi 'khor lo drug gi gtsug tor gsang gnas lte ba gsum nam mkha' ye shes pa'i yon tan ye shes rdo rje yin pas/ rten dang lhan skyes kyi sku brten pa/ snying mgrin dpral ba gsum po rlung me chu'i yon tan thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje yin pas/ rten dang chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum brten par bzhag ste/ gsang gtsug lte ba gsum lhan skyes kyi sku'i rten du 'gro tshul ni/ gzhi'i lhan skyes rdzogs pa ni lo bcu drug gi mthar byang sems rdzogs par 'phel ba'i bde ba yin la de la gsang gnas su ye shes kyi phung khams mtha' dag rdzogs dgos pas dang*/

gtsug tor nam mkha'i khams ni thugs rdo rje yin la thugs rdo rje ni ye shes rdo rje'am lhan skyes kyi rten yin pas dang*/ gtso bo'i rgyab zhal ye shes rdo rje'am lhan skyes kyi sku yin la de nub dus me'i khams la brten pas so/ /snying mgrin dpral gsum chos longs sprul sku'i rten du 'gro ba yang sku de gsum gyi rten gyi yon tan rlung me chu gsum yin pa'i phyir ro| |des na gtso bo'i zhal bzhi'i rgyu mtshan yang de grub bo/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'khor lo drug po de thabs shes kyi rigs drug tu yang 'gyur te/ ma las thob pa rdul gyi chos sa me ye shes kyi 'gyur ba gsum po nub lho 'og gsum gyi 'khor lo rin chen gri gug ste gtso mo'i sku gsung thugs gsum po lte mgrin gsang ba gsum/ pha las thob pa khu ba'i chos chu rlung nam mkha'i 'gyur ba gsum byung shar steng gi padma ral gri rdo rje ste gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs gsum po dpral snying gtsug tor gsum mo/ / gsum pa ni/ steng du zla nyi sgra gcan 'og tu bshang gci khu ba'i rtsa gsum ste ro rkyang dbu ma'i yas sna gsum dang mas sna gsum yin la/ de yang steng ma gsum po chu me nam mkha'/ 'og ma gsum po sa rlung ye shes su bshad pa las 'og tu bshang ba'i rtsa dang steng gi nyi ma 'bab pa g.yas pa'i rtsa dang*/ 'og gi khu ba 'bab pa gsum po ma las thob pa sogs nas gtso mo'i sku gsung thugs so/ /steng gi zla ba 'bab pa g.yon pa'i rtsa dang 'og gi gci ba 'bab pa dang*| steng gi dbu ma sgra gcan gyi rtsa rnams ni pha las thob pa sogs nas gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs so/ /'di dag ni dbang mdor bstan du/ zla nyi sgra gcan bshang gci dang*/ khu ba 'bab pa'i lam rnams su/ /chu me stong pa sa rlung dang*// ye shes khams rnams skyes rnams la/ /zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad de shin tu gsal bas der blta'o/

/ gnyis pa la lus dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ phan tshun 'khyud pas thabs shes su gnas tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ dus 'khor 'dir lus bsam du grags pa'i lus ni 'dzin pa'am yul can gyi chos dang*/ bsam pa ni yul lam bzung byar bshad la| de yang lha yab yum lta bu la/ yab la bltos nas rang nyid lus dang yum bsam pa/ yum la bltos nas yum rang nyid lus dang yab bsam pa'o/ /des na gzugs phung rnam snang*/ lung dbang sgrib sel/ bshang lam rengs byed rnams lus su song ba'i tshe/ rlung sgrol ma/ reg bya rdo rje ma/ bya ba bshang ba 'dzag pa rnams bsam pa ste/ lus sa khams ser po las bya ba rlung khams nag po phan tshun du lus bsam mo/ de bzhin du chu khams pa 'du shes/ lce rkang pa rnams dang*/ me khams pa/ me ro 'gro ba'i bya ba rnams phan tshun lus bsam/ me khams la tshor ba/ mig lag pa rnams dang*/ chu gzugs/ len pa'i bya ba rnams phan tshun lus bsam/ rlung khams la 'du byed/ sna kha rnams dang sa dri/ ngag smra ba rnams lus bsam/ nam mkha'i khams la rnam shes/ rna ba/ 'doms rnams dang*/ ye shes sgra/ dri chu 'dor ba rnams lus dang bsam pa/ ye shes khams la/ ye shes/ yid/ mchog gi dbang po rnams dang*/ nam mkha'/ chos/ khu ba 'pho ba rnams lus bsam du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na kha dog gi sgo nas shar nub kyi ser nag dang*/ lho byang gi dkar dmar dang*/ steng 'og gi ljang sngon lus bsam du bstan te/ de yang gtso bor nang gi rlung srog thur gnyis dang*| rtsa khams dkar dmar gnyis dang*/ dhū tī'i yas sna mas sna gnyis rnams lus bsam dang thabs shes yin pas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ lus kyi sha dang rus pa chu dang khrag drod dang dri chu/ rlung dang bshang ba rnams thabs shes su skabs 'dir gsungs pa'i don la/ lus la rus pa sha dang bral na lus srog mi gnas pas sha rus 'bral med dgos pa bzhin du/ sha rnam par dag pa don grub dang*/ rus rnam par dag pa spyan ma gnyis phan tshun lus bsam mam thabs shes su gsungs/

de bzhin du khrag chu dang bral na lus gnas kyi chu bskams pa'i khrag gis lus mi 'tsho bas zung 'brel dgos pa bzhin du khrag rin 'byung dang*/ chu mā ma ki thabs shes/ dri chu drod dang bral na lus mi 'tsho bas zung 'brel dgos pa bzhin du chu 'od dpag med dang*/ me gos dkar mo thabs shes/ bshang ba rlung dang bral na 'dor sdom mi nus pas zung 'brel dgos pa bzhin du bshang ba rnam snang dang*/ rlung sgrol ma thabs shes/ khu ba rdul dang bral na lus mi gnas pas zung 'brel dgos pa bzhin du khu ba rnam par dag pa mi bskyod pa dang*/ rdul rnam par dag pa sher phyin ma thabs shes/ de bzhin du sna nam mkha' dang*/ sgra ye shes gnyis thabs shes yin pa sogs rgyas par sbyar ro/ /de rnams ni lus 'phel ba'i rgyu tshogs yin te/ ji skad bshad pa'i rten dang brten pa dang*/ thabs shes sogs de rnams cha snyoms shing rim pa ma 'chol ba sogs kyi yon tan can du grub na lus kyi rtsa khams la sogs pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du 'phel bar 'gyur so/ / gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin/ mngal zla gnyis pa nas brtsams te zhag re la rtsa phran nyis brgya re 'phel bas zhag sum brgya drug cu'i bar du rtsa 'phel bas rtsa bdun khri nyis stong rdzogs shing de'i phyi nyin nas zhag re la rtsa phran gnyis gnyis bskams pas/ zhag drug cu la rtsa brgya nyi shu/ lo gcig la bdun brgya nyi shu/ lo brgya'i zhag sum khri drug stong la bdun khri nyis stong chad par 'gyur te/ rgyas par rtsa 'chad tshul du bshad par bya'o/ /rtsa 'phel ba rdzogs nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du dmar cha dang bcu drug gi bar du dkar cha 'phel zhing de nas 'phel ba rdzogs te nyams pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin no/ /rlung 'phel tshul ni/ ye le'i brgya zhe gsum par/ btsas ma thag ye shes kyi rlung rdzogs pa'i rjes kyi rlung dang po yon tan med pa gcig de rjes snying stobs rdul mun gyi rlung re re ste dang po khyab byed du byas nas grangs mi 'dzin pas/

gsum po de la zla ba'i yon tan lnga lnga'i dbye bas bco lnga/ de la sgo gsum gyi dbang gis zhe lnga/ de la gza'i 'gros bzhi'i dbang gis brgya brgyad cu/ de thabs shes kyi dbang gis sum brgya drug cu ste g.yas g.yon gang rung gi 'pho chung dkyil 'khor gcig de bzhin du dkyil 'khor bcu ka rim gyis 'phel nas dkyil 'khor drug cus nyin mtshan rdzogs te g.yas g.yon gyi 'pho ba rdzogs pas rtsa stong phrag don gnyis rlung gis gang bar gsungs pas mngal nang du rtsa phran la rlung med par bstan/ 'dir dus kyi rtsa zhes yang yang bshad pas 'pho mtshams kyi bu lon med par bstan zhes jo nang pas zer te brtag go /'di la rong pa sher seng rtsa chad pa dang khams 'phel ba 'gal bas lo bcu drug gi bar du rtsa la 'phel 'grib med zer ba mi 'thad de de lta na lo brgya la rtsa chad pa mi rdzogs pas so/ /de na rtsa khams khyad par can rnams kyi ngo bo'i 'phel tshul ni de ltar yin pas mngal zla gnyis pa nas bgrangs pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis rdzogs nas rtsa'i ngo bo la gsar 'phel med kyi steng du zhag re la rtsa phran gnyis gnyis 'grib kyang grub zin rnams kyi khyad par ni lus kyi stobs rtsal ji srid skye skye'i bar du 'phel ba dang*/ khams dkar dmar yang mngal chags nas zla ba bcu gsum bar gyi mi 'phel zhing*| de nas lo bcu gnyis bar du dmar cha dang bcu drug gi bar du dkar cha 'phel ba rdzogs te de nas khams kyi ngo bo gsar 'phel med kyang grub zin gyi khyad par ni lus stobs la yang skyed ji srid yod kyi bar du 'phel zhing lus kyi shed stobs nyams pa nas bzung ste/ zad dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis bar skabs su cung zad 'phel ba srid kyang*/ ngo bo dang khyad par gyi rgyun la bltos pa'i 'phel ba med par shes par bya'o/ / gsum pa gnas tshul la gnyis/ phyi dang sbyar ba dang*/ gzhan dang sbyar ba'i gnas tshul lo/

/ dang po la lnga/ rang bzhin dang skyes bur phyi nang mtshungs par/ rlung gi rang bzhin du/ rtsa'i rang bzhin du rgyu tshul dang*/ zhing sogs su gnas tshul lo/ /dang po la/ mu stegs grangs can 'dod pa'i rang bzhin nyi shu rtsa lngar grags pa dang lus 'di mtshungs par gnas pa ste/ 'di la mtshungs yul mu stegs kyi 'dod pa la khams le'i tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i 'grel par bshad par grangs can snga rabs pa'am/ sham bha la'i grangs can gyi 'dod pa dang*/ dbu tshad kyi 'grel bar 'byung ba grangs can phyi rabs pa'am/ 'phags yul gyi grangs can pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rang bzhin gtso bo zhes bya ba bzhi pa'i gnas skabs bskyed par byed pa ste rang bzhin kho na/ de las sa chu me rlung yid blo nga rgyal te bdun 'byung la de ni rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ka de rnams las dbang po lnga yul lnga las dbang lnga mchog gi dbang po ste bcu drug 'byung ba ni rnam 'gyur kho na/ nyer lnga pa shes rig gi skyes bu ni/ longs spyod pa po rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ka ma yin pa ste/ ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'o zhes bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum cha mnyam pa'i gtso bo rtag pa ba gcig pu cha med ni rang bzhin kho na/ de las blo'am che po zhes bya ba 'dod de me long ngos gnyis pa lta bu/ de las nga rgyal de la rdul mun snying stobs shas che ba gsum 'byung rdul shas che ba las gang yang mi 'byung*/ mun pa shas che ba las gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste de tsam lnga/ de las nam mkha' sa chu me rlung ste 'byung ba lnga/ snying stobs shas che ba las dbang po lnga/ las dbang lnga/ gnyis ka'i dbang po yid dang bcu gcig 'byung*/ de ltar na blo yi chen po 'byung*/ nga rgyal dang de tsam lnga ste bdun ni rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gnyis ka ste gzhan las byung zhing gzhan bskyed pas so/ /dbang po bcu gcig dang 'byung ba lnga ste bcu drug ni rnam 'gyur kho na ste/

gzhan las byung zhing gzhan mi bskyed pas so/ /shes rig ni/ rig pa gcig pu cha med za ba po rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gang yang ma yin pa ste 'di kho na shes rig yin la/ gzhan thams cad bem por 'dod do/ /mthun tshul la phyi mthun tshul ni/ khams le'i tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i 'grel par gsungs te/ nam mkha' ni gtso bo/ sa chu me rlung rang ming*/ zla nyi sgra gcan ni yid blo nga rgyal gsum/ gza' lnga ni dbang po lnga/ yul lnga rang ming*/ ro drug ni las dbang drug tu gsungs la/ shes rig gi mtshungs chos la sbyar mod kyi/ phyi rol stong pa gcig pu lta bu la sbyor bar mngon no/ /'di nang la sbyar na/ mngal dang btsas pa'i gnas skabs kun gyi bzhi pa'i gnas skabs skyed par byed pa'i thig le 'gyur med ni gtso bo ste nam mkha'i khams zhes kyang bya'o/ /sa sogs bzhi dang*/ yon tan gsum dang bcas pa'i yid rtog bcas dang*/ zhen pas bsdus pa'i shes rig ni blo/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal sogs khengs pa'i cha ni nga rgyal/ dbang po lnga dang las dbang lnga dang yul lnga dang mchog gi dbang po rnams ni rnam 'gyur bcu drugasems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ni shes rig tu gsungs te/ de ltar lus kyi chos 'di dag ni/ rang bzhin dang skyes bu'i tshul du gnas par brjod do/ / gnyis pa la mtshan nyid mtshungs pa dang*/ grangs sogs mtshungs par gnas tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ lus kyi sra bsher tsha yang rnams ni/ phyi'i sa chu me rlung*/ bug pa ni nam mkha'/ sgal tshigs mtha' dag ni ri rab/ lce chung gi bdud rtsi ni char pa/ rgyu ma 'phrog pa'i sgra ni rdo rje'i sgra ste 'brugagashang ba ni 'ja' tshon sogs te/ gzhan yang mdog dbyibs sogs kyi mtshan nyid ji ltar mtshungs pa rnams te/ lus 'di phyi 'jig rten khams dang mdog dbyibs mtshungs par gnas zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dbugs sogs chu tshod sogs dang mtshungs par gnas te| nang gi dbugs re re ni phyi'i chu tshod re re dang mtshungs te/

dbugs zung dgu brgya nyis 'gyur zhes pa nyis 'gyur te/ 'byung 'jug zung re dbugs gcig tu bgrangs pa'i stong brgyad brgya la chu tshod lnga yong zhing chu tshod lnga lnga la nang gi g.yas g.yon gyi 'pho chen re re yong ba bzhin du phyi'i chu tshod stong brgyad brgya la zhag drug tshan lnga lnga ste 'pho zla gcig yong bas so/ /de ltar na nangagi 'pho chen bcu gnyis la dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yod bas/ zhag re la nang gi lor 'jog pa bzhin du phyi'i 'pho zla'am khyim zla bcu gnyis la chu tshod nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar yong bas phyi'i lo gcig rdzogs so/ /des na nang gi zhag brgya la lo brgya'i tha snyad mdzad pa'i skabs 'gar re mdzad yod pa rnams shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du skar rtsis pa rnams bug pa'i dbye bas so/ /zhes pas bug pa gza' la sogs pa dang mtshungs par gnas te/ zhi gza' rnams g.yon gyi bug pa dang drag gza' rnams g.yas kyi bug pa dang sbyar nas gnas pa'i phyir te/ bshang gci'i bug pa zla nyi khu ba dang kha'i bug pa dus me sgra gcan mig g.yon g.yas lhag pa mig dmar/ sna g.yon g.yas pa sangs phur bu/ rna ba g.yon g.yas mjug ring spen pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ 'o na srung 'khor gyi gza' sogs spro ba'i skabs su sgra dus rna ba g.yon g.yas nas spro bar gsungs pa ni spro bya dang spro sa gnyis ka nam mkha'i khams su 'thad la/ zla nyi sna g.yon g.yas nas spro ba yang gnyis ka rlung khams dang mthun par 'thad cing*/ phur bu pa sangs lce dang chu lam nas spro ba yang lce dang phur bu chu khams par mthun par 'thad mod kyi/ 'dir bshad pa rnams khams ma mthun pas mi 'thad cing*/ zhi gza' g.yon dang drag gza' g.yas kyi bug pa'i nges pa yang nyams te/ zla ba g.yon du 'ong rigs pa las bshang lam gyi rtsa 'og gi g.yas dang gci ba'i rtsa mdun na yod pas so zhe na/ skyon med de/ zla ba'i lam gyis bshang ba'i rtsa/

nyi mas gci ba 'bab pa ste/ zhes gsungs pas bshang gci'i bug pa gnyis rim pa bzhin rkyang ma dang ro ma'i rtsa rgyun yin pas so/ khu ba'i bug pa 'og gi rtsa gsum gyi g.yas phyogs na yang gnas shing*/ de ye shes kyi khams dang kha'i bug pa dbu ma'i yas sna rjes mthun pa yin pas nam mkha'i khams yin zhing*/ nam mkha' ye shes steng 'og g.yon dang g.yas kyi chos yin pas 'thad do/ /rna ba dang spen mjug khams mi mthun kyang rna ba'i yul dang yul can nam mkha' ye shes yin/ de gnyis la bsad gso bya bar gsungs shing*/ spen mjug kyang bsad gso'i gzar gsungs pas mthun/ sna dang phur sangs khams ma mthun kyang zla bo rnams bkod pa'i zla stobs kyis bzhag pa tsam las rgyu mtshan btsal dka'o/ /'dir kha 'phangs mdzad pa'i ye le'i nyis brgya so drug par mu stegs kyi rigs kyi mdo'i skabs su/ mig rna ba sna lce lus yid de dbang po drug po mig dmar/ lhag pa/ pa sangs/ phur bu/ spen pa/ mjug ring rnams su gsungs shing*/ mngal gyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ dga' ba/ rdul/ khu ba rnams/ sgra gcan/ dus me/ nyi ma zla ba rnams su gsungs so/ /'di'i rgyu mtshan dka' na'ang mu stegs dang bstun pas skyon med do/ /lus kyi so sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyu skar dang mtshungs te/ zur gyi steng 'og gnyis gnyis te bzhi ni dbyu gu'i rgyu skar bzhi yin la/ lhag ma steng 'og tu bcu bzhi bcu bzhi ni rgyu skar byi bzhin dang bcas pa'i nyer brgyad po rim min gyi rkang pa bcu bzhi la rgyu ba'i bcu bzhi pa phrag gnyis dang mthun te/ 'di la'ang grangs mthun pa tsam du ma zad kyi rim par skye ba dang rim min du skyes bas rkang pa la spyod tshul dang mthun pas bzhag go las 'khor sum brgya drug cu ni nyin mtshan gyi dbyu gu'i dbugs grangs dang lo'i nyin zhag dang mtshungs te/ grangs sum brgya drug cu mnyam pa dang de dag la spyod pa'i thig le thams cad mtshungs so/

/rtsa stong phrag don gnyis ni/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo stong phrag don gnyis dang mtshungs te ro'am khu ba 'bab cing grangs mtshungs so/ /rgyu ma ni char sprin dang mtshungs te ro 'bab cing sgra sgrog pas so/ khams bcu drug ni tshes zhag dang mtshungs te/ spu sogs khams brgyad pa gnyis gnyis phye bas bcu drug dang lus kyi gnas bcu drug la khu ba 'phel ba'i cha bcu drug la tshes zhag 'jog pas so/ /dang po ni spu la phra rags gnyis dang*| pags pa la srab 'thug gnyis/ khrag dang sha la phyi nang gnyis gnyis/ rtsa la phra rags gnyis/ rgyus pa dang rkang la phyi nang gnyis gnyis rnams dang*/ khu ba la ska sla gnyis su phye ba rnams so/ /spu dang*/ shig dang*/ srin bu rags pa dang*| khu ba dang srin bu mig gis mi bzod pa'i phra mo rnams skye gnas bzhi dang mtshungs te/ spu ni brtan pa'i rdzus skyes/ shig sgong skyes/ srin bu rags pa drod bsher skyes/ khu ba mngal skyes/ srin bu phra ba rdzus skyes chen po ro'i skye gnas can yin pas so/ /rkang lag gi sor tshigs drug cu po lo gcig la dus drug tu byas pa'i dus kyi zhag grangs dang mtshungs te/ dkar phyogs la mthe'u chung nas spro rim dang nag phyogs la mthe bong nas sdud rim ste/ de yang tshig phreng dang po gnyis pa gsum pa rnams mun rdul snying stobs kyi dbye bas dga' ba bzang po rgyal ba stong pa rdzogs pa rnams dang po gnyis pa gsum pa ste tshar gsum g.yon la dang*/ g.yas kyi tshig phreng gsum pa gnyis pa dang po rnams snying stobs rdul mun gyi dbye bas sbyar ba'i lag pa la sbyar ba zla ba dang po dang*/ rkang pa la sbyar ba zla ba gnyis pa ste tshar drug gis lo rdzogs so/ /spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar dang*| de nas dpyi'i bar dang*/ de nas rkang mthil gyi bar rnams mtho ris mi yul sa 'og rnams dang mtshungs te/ 'di yang steng 'og bar gsum du mtshungs pa tsam du ma zad kyi/

gsang gnas man chad ye shes kyi khams la brten pa'i dus me'i skye ba dmyal ba la sbyar ba lta bu dang mthun/ lte ba sa khams yin pa ni/ mi dang dud 'gro khams drug ldan yin pa dang mthun pa sogs kyi lus kyi khams kyi dbang gis phyi'i khams phal cher bzhag pa'o/ /yang lus kyi gsher 'jam sra ba'i khams gsum po rnams mtsho dang gling dang ri rnams dang mtshungs par gnas te/ dri chu dang*/ rdul dang*/ lce chung gi bdud rtsi dang*/ bud med kyi 'o ma'am skyes pa'i bad kan dang*/ klad pa dang*/ zhag dang*/ khu ba rnams ni rim pa bzhin| lan tshwa dang*/ chang dang*/ chu dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ zho dang*/ mar dang*/ sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho rnams dang mtshungs/ rkang lag gi dum bu bcu gnyis/ sha mchin pa| snying*/ tshil bu/ rgyu ma/ rtsa rnams ni gling*/ 'dzam gling*/ drag po/ khrung khrung*/ mi'am ci/ ku sha 'od dkar/ zla ba'i gling rnams so/ /rkang lag gi sen mo/ lag mthil/ lag ngar/ dpung lhu/ rkang pa/ rkang ngar/ brla rnams kyi rus pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje/ bsil ri/ dro med/ nor bu'i 'od/ bi ṣa ṭa/ manda ra/ 'od sngon rnams so/ /sgal tshig mtha' dag ni ri brgyad pa lhun po'o// lus kyi khrag dang pags pa ni me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po'o/ /skra dang mchan khung dang 'doms kyi skra rnams ni mkha' spyod sa spyod sa 'og na spyod pa'i grub pa rnams so/ / snying ga'i padma gzhu dbyibs dang*/ mgrin pa zlum po dang*/ lte ba gru bzhi rnams ni rim pa ltar glog gam lho'i me'am rta gdong gi me dang*/ khyim bdag gi me zhes grags pa nyi ma dang*/ sha za'am sreg bya za ba'i me zhes bya ste de gsum las kyi me yin la/ de dag las yon tan gong ma gnas pa gtum mo'i me ni/ dri med 'od zer 'phro ba ye shes kyi gzugs can mun pa las me dag gi mthar gnas pa lte gsang dpral ba na gnas pa'o/ /lus kyi rtsa 'khor rnams gza' la sogs pa dang mtshungs par gnas te/

snying ga'i rtsa brgyad kyi shar nyi ma| shar lho zla ba/ lho dang lho nub mig dmar dang lhag pa/ nub dang nub byang phur sangs/ byang dang byang shar spen pa dang rigs ldan kyi ming can sgra gcan te byang shar gyi phyed kyang mjug rings so/ /'dir phur sangs nub tu byung ba/ tshe'i 'khor lo dang 'dra bar rtsa de gnyis la gza' de gnyis kyi longs spyod gnas pa'i dbang gis yin la/ srung 'khor du gza' de gnyis byang du 'byung ba ni gza' rang gi khams kyi dbang gis yin no/ /lte ba'i rtsa 'khor chu tshod dang mtshungs te bzhi stong pa 'bab pa dang drug cu po re re nas chu tshod re re'i rlung 'bab pas so/ /dpral ba'i bcu drug zla rkang du gnas te/ gnyis ni stong pa 'bab la/ bdun phyogs gcig la rim pa bzhin 'byung dang 'byung ba sogs dang phyogs gcig la lugs ldog tu gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ de yang chu tshod lnga dang lnga la sogs pa 'bab pas so/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa so gnyis rgyu skar du gnas te| bzhi ni stong pa 'bab la/ mtshams bzhir gnas shing*/ lhag ma rnams phyogs bzhir bdun bdun gnas pa'i shar gyi dbus ma nam gru/ de nas g.yon skor du tha skar sogs gnas te byi bzhin dang bcas pa'i nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ / las 'khor bcu gnyis ni chu srang du gnas te/ chu tshod drug cu'i chu srang sum stong drug brgya po bcu gnyis kyis bgos pas chu srang sum brgya re 'khor lo re thob la| 'khor lo re re la rtsa sum cu ma yod pas rtsa re nas chu srang bcu re ste chu tshod kyi drug cha re rgyu bas so/ / gsum pa rlung gi rang bzhin du gnas tshul la gnyis lte ba srog lung gi dang*/ snying ga rlung chu'i rang bzhin du gnas tshul lo/ / dang po la/ rtsa chen bcu gnyis la 'bab pa'i 'pho chen/ yal ga drug bcu la 'bab pa'i 'pho chung*/ 'pho chung so so'i bdag po ngos bzung ba'o/ / dang po la/ rlung spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ gzhung la sbyar ba'o/

/ dang po la/ spyir rlung tsam gyi ngo bo ni g.yo bar byed pa'i las gtso bor ldan pas rang gang la ldan pa'i chos srog ldan lta bur ston pas na srog ces pa'i sgra bshad du rung ba'i ngo bo'o/ /dbye na phyi nang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jig rten chags pa la dgos pa/ 'dzin par byed pa dang*/ srub par byed pa dang*/ dbyibs su byed pa'i rlung gsum gtso bor chags nas gnas pa la dgos pa'i phyir srog 'dzin dang thur sel la sogs pa bcu'o/ /nang gi rlung la/ sngar bshad pa ltar ches shin tu phra ba dang*/ shin tu phra ba dang*/ phra mo dang*/ rags pa de bzhir gnas pa ni rim pa ltar gzhom med kun 'gro ste sangs rgyas kyi sar yang 'gro ba yin la/ 'di sems dang ngo bo gcig pas rlung dngos min pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sa na rlung med par gsungs pa dang*/ gzugs med dang bar do'i sems can la'ang yod pa dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs na yod pa dang*| sad pa'i gnas skabs na rdzogs par rgyu'o/ /yang na ye shes kyi rlung zhes bya ba rtog med bde chen gyi rten yon tan can dang*/ las kyi rlung zhes bya ba rtog bcas sdug bsngal gyi rten skyon can gnyis su gnas par 'dir yang gsungs shing*| rgyud rdor phreng dang*/ sambu ṭi dang*/ phyag chen thig le'i rgyud rnams su gsungs te/ rnam rtog med pa'i rlung shar na/ /gang shes rdo rje sems dpa' yi// rang dngos go 'phang bzang po thob/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rlung chen po/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ / dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin mchog/sgom dang sgom min gong 'phang bral/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gnyis ni/ /lus kun la ni khyab par byed/ /sna yi bu ga mas ni rgyu/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /'di'i ye shes ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i zlas grangs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung la mi byed ste/ de ni sna bug gnyis ka'i dbus nas mnyam por rgyu ba'i phyir ro/

/rgyud 'di dang rdor phreng sogs su rlung gi ngo bo dbye bsdu sogs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams ni rags pa'am las rlung nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ 'dus pa phyi ma las/ 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin dbugs/ ye shes lnga yis ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan brtag

/rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/ /ces so/ /dbye ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas/ srog 'dzin thur sel mnyam gnas gyen rgyu khyab byed de rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ 'di dang rgyud rdor phreng du/ klu dang rtsangs pa dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ lhas byin dang gzhu las rgyal lam nor las rgyal te lnga'am gzhung gzhan du rgyu ba dang*/ rnam par rgyu ba dang*/ yang dag par rgyu ba dang*/ rab tu rgyu ba dang*/ nges par rgyu ba zhes pa'i ming 'dogs kyang 'byung ba ste/ mdor na yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcur gsungs la sngar bshad pa'i dga' ba dang lhan skyes kyi rlung gnyis ni 'og gi rlung thur sel gyi bye brag tu 'dus so/ /gnas kyi sgo nas lus kyi bu ga dgu'am bcu gnyis nas rgyu bas de snyed dam/ ba spu'i bu ga re re nas rgyu bas de snyed du'ang gsungs sa/ོ gtso bor sna'i bu ga nas rgyu ba la 'byung rngub zung la re re bgrangs pa'i sems can rang rang gi zhag re la rang rang gi rlung rnams nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re rgyu bas de snyed du'ang dbye'o/ /bsdu na rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis su'ang 'du la/ gtso bor srog thur gnyis su'ang 'du zhing*/ steng rlung srog 'dzin ni/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyi rlung gsum dang 'og rlung thur sel ni bshang gci khu ba'i rlung gsum du 'du la/ snga ma gsum po nyin zhag re la 'pho chen bcu gnyis su 'du ste/ sna bug g.yas g.yon re nas 'pho chen drug drug 'byung bas so| |de gnyis kyi 'pho mtshams ye shes kyi rlung yang gang gi mjug tu byung ba'i 'pho mtshams de 'pho chen de'i nang du khyab byed kyi tshul du bsdu bas so// de yang nyi khri chig stong drug brgya po'i steng nas drug drug la chu srang re re byed pas chu srang sum stong drug brgya/ chu srang drug cu re la chu tshod rer byed pas chu tshod drug cu tham pa/ chu tshod lnga lnga la 'pho chen re byed pas 'pho chen bcu gnyis 'byung ba yin la/

'pho chen re re la sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lnga lnga 'byung bas| 'pho chung lnga lngar grags pas 'pho chung drug cu ste 'pho chung dang chu tshod don gcig go/ de yang zhib tu brtsi na chu srang nga drug bzhi cha la chu tshod rer byas nas chu srang bzhi rkang chad re ste/ dbugs bcu gcig bzhi cha re ye shes kyi rlung du 'gro bas de 'dra lnga bsdoms pa'i nga drug bzhi cha pa gcig ye shes kyi rlung du byas nas 'pho mtshams su rgyu'o/ /de dag kyang g.yas pa'i 'pho chung rnams la chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams su sdud rim gyis mchu dang ka ba dang mkhur tshos dang steng dang dbus rnams nas rgyu la/ g.yon nas nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i tshul du spro rim gyi gnas snga ma las ldog ste rgyu la/ 'pho mtshams nga drug bzhi cha po gnyis ka'i dbus nas cha mnyam por rgyu bar de dag ye shes kyi rlung dang 'byung ba'i rlung zhes gnyis su bsdu na'ang rung ngo*/ /'byung ba rnams kyi kha dog kyang 'byung ba so so'i kha dog dang rtsa ba'i gnas kyang lte ba kho na nas rgyu zhing de yang sa rlung lte ba'i rtsa ba nas byung zhing sna sgor sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du phyin nas ldog la/ chu me rlung ye bzhi po lte ba nas sor gcig dang*/ gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*| bzhi yi sa nas byung ste sna sgor sor bcu gsum dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga dang bcu drug gi bar du 'gro zhing de las ldog par 'dir gsungs/ 'pho chen bcu gnyis kyang lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi 'dab ma bcu gnyis po'i g.yon pa drug nas rgyu ba rnams rkyang ma brgyud de sna bug g.yon dang g.yas pa drug nas brgyus pa rnams ro ma brgyud de g.yas nas rgyu bar gsungs la/ 'pho chung yang lte ba'i rtsa bcu gnyis po re re la lnga lnga gyes pa'i sa chu me rlung gi rtsa lnga po las g.yon spro rim dang g.yas sdud rim du ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sna bug gnyis ka nas kyang 'byung la/

'pho mtshams dbu ma las byung ba rnams mnyam rgyur 'byung bar gsungs so/ /'dir ni de ltar srog rlung thams cad lte ba nas rgyu bas rtsa ba'i rlung dang yan lag gi rlung yang lus kyi gnas khyad par ba so so na yod par ma gsungs kyi snying ga'i rtsa bcu las mnyam gnas rus sbal shar gyi rtse la spyod pa sogs sngar bshad pa tsam zhig gsungs so/ /rgyud rdor phreng sogs su/ srog 'dzin chu rlung dkar po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin snying ga na gnas zhing*/ sna bug gnyis ka nas cha mnyam du dal bar rgyu ba dang*/ thur sel sa rlung ser po rin 'byung gi rang bzhin 'doms na gnas pa sna bug gnyis ka nas cha mnyam du drag por rgyu ba dang*/ gyen rgyu me rlung dmar po snang mtha'i rang bzhin mgrin pa na gnas nas sna bug g.yas kho na nas rgyu ba dang*/ mnyam gnas rlung gi rlung ljang nag don grub kyi rang bzhin lte bar gnas nas sna bug g.yon pa kho na nas rgyu ba dang*/ khyab byed nam mkha'i rlung sngon po rnam snang gi rang bzhin lus kun la gnas pa da lta mi rgyu zhing 'chi khar dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu/ mgon po gzhan bzhi po'ang rgyu thengs re la dgu brgya pa phrag re re ste bzhi bsdoms pas dbugs sum stong drug brgya ste chu tshod bcu bcu/ de lan drug 'khor bas chu tshod drug cu ste| mgon po re re'i rgyu thengs re la thun phyed phyed du byas pas zhag gcig la thun nam 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang*/ 'pho ba re la mgon po gnyis gnyis rgyu bar bshad do/ /mgon po re re la spyan ma/ ma mā ki gos dkar/ sgrol ma ste lha mo bzhi bzhis bgos pas nyis brgya nyer lnga ste/ sna bug gi bu ga'i phyogs ni/ rdor phreng dang sambu ṭir/ steng dang ngos dang drang 'og 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ steng phyogs dang*/ ngos gsegs dang*/ drang po ka ba dang*/ 'og mchu la brdar nas rgyu bar sgron gsal sogs su bshad la/

lha mo bzhi po'ang rnam snang gi rlung la spyan ma dang por rgyu ba sogs mgon po rang rang gi yum dang sbyar bar bshad do| |de dag 'dir bshad pa dang ma mthun sems pa'i 'gal spong la/ slob dpon a bha ya'i man ngag snye mar 'dir bshad drang don du bshad pa ni/ bsdus rgyud 'dus pa sogs la mos pa'i don du gsungs na rigs kyi gzhan du mi 'thad de/ sems 'grel rnams su 'dus pa bde mchog sogs kyi dngos bstan la slob dpon la bltos pa'i don du dgongs nas gsungs pa dang dkrugs te gsungs par lan mang du gsungs shing myong bas kyang brtag par nus pa'i phyir ro| |rtsa ba'i rlung dang yan lag gis rlung gi byed las sogs ni/ 'dir nang le'u zhe gsum zhe bzhi par bshad pa dang*/ rgyud rdor phreng sogs kyang phal cher mthun te/ srog 'dzin gyis srog byed/ thug sel gyis bshang gci sogs 'dzin 'dor byed/ mnyam gnas kyi zas dang khams snyom par byed/ gyen rgyus lus gyen du g.yo ba dang ngag smra/ khyab byed kyis lus na ba dang 'jig par byed/ klus sgrags pa dang*/ rus sbal gyi yan lag bskum pa dang*/ rtsangs pas sems khro g.yengs/ lhas byin gyis glal ba dang*/ nor las rgyal gyis lus mi gtong bar 'dzin pa rnams byed pas shi ba'i lus la'ang nor las rgyal yod par gsungs so/ /yan lag gi rlung lnga'i byed las bzhi ni dbang shes yul la 'jug pa'i bya ba byed par gsang 'dus rim lnga las gsungs te/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ sems dang lhan cig 'dres gyur te// dbang po'i sgo yi lam nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di dag gi khams kyang rim pa bzhin sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams su bzhed par gsal te| yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams rim pa bzhin| rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa| rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams su gsungs pas/ yul de rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams su grub cing 'dus pa ba rang rigs la sbyor bas so/

/gzhung don ni/ tshigs bcad so brgyad pa 'dis nang gi 'pho ba thams cad la phyi'i lo zla dus sbyor nyi rkang gi 'phel 'grib thams cad tshang bar gsungs pa yin te/ de yang rkang pa bzhi pa/ dus sbyor tshad dang nor dang bu lon mnyam pa dag kyang bgrod pa g.yas dang g.yon la shes par bya/ zhes pa bu lon bgrod pa dag kyang mnyam dang g.yas dang g.yon la shes par bya/ zhes 'gyur cung zad bcos par bya zhing*/ 'grel pa'i thur ma bdun gyis so/ /dus sbyor tshad shes par bya/ zhes pa'i bar gyi rdzogs tshig kyang mi 'grig pas thur ma bdun gyis dus sbyor zhes sbyar na legs so/ /de yang nang gi zhag gcig dang phyi rol gyi lo gcig legs par sbyar nas shes par bya ste/ dbang mdor bstan las| lte ba'i padma'i 'dab ma la/ /dkyil 'khor drug cu rnams rim bzhin// g.yon dang g.yas pa'i dus sbyor ni/ /lug sogs glang la sogs pas so// zhes lte ba'i g.yon gyi 'dab ma drug ni/ lug sogs mi mnyam pa dang*/ g.yas kyi drug ni/ glang sogs mnyam pa'i khyim drug yin la/ de ltar na phyi rol tu nyi mas khyim bcu gnyis ma 'khor bar du lo mi rdzogs pa ni nang du rlung gis nang gi khyim bcu gnyis ma rdzogs bar du zhag rdzogs mi srid pa'i phyir te/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i nyi ma bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis mtshungs pas so/ /des na nang gi chos thams cad rlung sems gnyis su bsdus pa'i tshe/ rlung ni nyi ma yin pas rlung la nyi ma dang*/ ye shes su gsungs pa ni/ rig pa dang khu ba gnyis ka sems su bsdus pa'i tshe de zla ba dang rnam shes yin pas so/ de ltar na phyi rol gyi lo la khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu dang bgrod pa gnyis dang*/ dus drug dang bzhi dang gsum dang*/ chu tshod nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rnams yong ba yang*/ nang la chu srang bcu phrag sum brgya drug cu dang nang gi bgrod pa gnyis la sogs pa dang*| dbugs de snyed yod pas so/

/phyi rol nyi ma'i skyes khyim karka ṭa nas rtsom pa yang*/ nang gi nyi ma'i skyes khyim karka ṭa yin pas so/ /'di la kha cig rlung mngal du chags pa'i thog ma la 'dod/ kha cig phyi rol tu btsas nas rgyu ba'i thog ma la 'dod/ snga mas mngal dang por chags pa'i zla ba chu srin du gsungs la/ chu srin nas ba bdun pa la karka ṭa'i khyim 'byung ba bzhin du mngal chags nas zla ba pas so/ /zhes zer zhing*/ phyi mas de mi 'grig ste/ 'dir lte ba'i 'dab ma la rlung 'khor zhing 'pho bar gsungs pa gang zhig mngal na rlung rtsa nang nas 'pho ba dang rgyu ba med pas so/ zhes zer ba de gnyis ni/ phyi ma jo nang pa dang snga ma bu ston rjes 'brang gi lugs yin mod kyi/ phyi ma legs te| 'dir 'grel par skyes pa thams cad dus sbyor gang du skyes par gyur pa de khyim ni karka ṭa'i ming can du rigs par bya ste srog gi skye ba gnas par bya zhes pa'i rigs pas so/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'dis kyang snga ma'i 'dod pa de ston mi nus shing gzhan pa'i sgrub byed kyang med la/ phyi rol nyi khyim gyi chad lhag nyin zhag gis rigs pa bzhin du nang du 'pho ba'i chad lhag dbugs kyis rigs par bya zhes gsungs la mngal du dbugs la chad lhag med pa'i phyir dang*/ nyi ma'i skyes khyim sbyangs nas rkang pa'i nor dang bu lon rtogs dgos pa bzhin du rlung gi thog ma ye shes kyi rlung nga drug bzhi cha po rgyus ma tshar bar du nang gi 'pho ba la nor dang bu lon med pas so/ /srog gi nus pa zhes pas kyang lugs snga ma mi 'grub ste/ srog dang nus pa dang mchog gi cha la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs yin pas gzhi mthun gyi bsdu ba yin gyi srog gi nus pa zhes pas srog gi rgyu ston pa min pas so/ /de ltar na mngal nas btsas ma thag pa'i dus de nyin mtshan gyi snga dgongs phyi'i dus sbyor gang gi tshe yin kyang 'dra/ byis pa de'i nang gi dus sbyor ni karka ṭa kho na yin par btags te/

de nas nyi zla'i longs spyod la sgra gcan gyis spyad pas 'phel 'grib kyi bu lon 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na nyin zhag gcig la ye shes kyi rlung nga drug bzhi cha ba bcu gnyis bsdoms pas drug brgya don lnga 'byung*/ dbugs dang phyi'i chu tshod dod thub yin pas chu tshod drug brgya don lnga la zhag bcu gcig bzhi cha 'byung ba bzhin du dbugs de la yang nang gi zhag bcu gcig bzhi cha 'byung bas de 'pho rlung gi steng nas chad pa bzhin du| phyi'i lo gcig la tshes zhag bcu gcig bzhi cha 'pho zla'am tshes zla'i steng nas chad pas lo gcig la tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu'i steng du bcu gcig bzhi cha ma bsnan bar du lo mi rdzogs pas tshes zla sum cu so phyed dang gsum na tshes zla re lhag por snon dgos pa bzhin du/ nang du zhag re la chu srang bcu phrag bcu gcig bzhi cha re 'pho rlung gi steng nas chad pa bsags pas tshes zhag sum cu so phyed dang gsum na tshes zhag re lhag por 'byung la/ bar skabs su chad pa'i dbang gis zla ba'i cha shas 'phel ba dang 'grib pa myur bas zla re la tshes lhag pa las chad pa grags mang bar byung ba yin no/ /de yang nang gi 'pho ba re'i mtshams su nga drug bzhi cha chad pa bzhin du phyi'i khyim re'i 'pho mtshams su chu srang nga drug bzhi cha la zhag tu byas pa'i zhag re chad pa yin no/ /'o na phyi'i chad lhag dus nges pa can du 'ong rigs pa las nges med du 'ong ba ci zhe na/ phyi'i zhag sum cu dang nang gi chu srang bcu phrag sum cu la 'pho mtshams su bshad pa 'di kun la bca' dgram yar mtho mar dman snyoms pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ sngar bshad ltar khyim yun ring thung shin tu mi mtshungs pa'i dbang gis yin no// des na nang gi lho bgrod byang bgrod sna bug g.yas g.yon la byed pa ni lho byang gi rgyu mtshan tsam yod pas 'khrul pa yin te/ gzhan du na phyi ru zla ba res mos kyi lho bgrod byang bgrod yod par 'gyur ro/

/des na phyi nang gang yin kyang karka ṭa sogs drug la rkang pa'i longs spyod bu lon dang chu srin sogs drug la nor du 'gyur te/ kar sogs drug po khyim yun ring la gzhan drug thung bas na bu lon dor bas rtag pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa 'gor la nor du byin pas rtag longs dang*| rkang longs gnyis ka bsdoms pas/ rtag longs rdzogs par myur ba'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ dbang mdor bstan du/ rnam shes la sogs dkyil 'khor lnga/ /rtag tu g.yon pa'i rtsa la ste/ /sa sogs g.yas kyi rtsa la'o/ /dbus ma nas ni mnyam pa 'bab/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar te/ phyi ru khyim zla gcig la dkyil 'khor lnga 'char te/ zhag drug gi chu tshod sum brgya drug cu re la dkyil 'khor sa sogs re re 'char ba'i phyir te/ de ltar yong ba ni/ nang du 'pho chen re la 'pho chung dkyil 'khor lnga lnga sngar bshad pa ltar sna bug gnyis kyi phyogs lnga nas 'byung ba lnga sdud spro'i rim pas g.yas g.yon nas 'bab pa 'pho mtshams nga drug bzhi cha yang 'pho chung re re'i bar nas bcu gcig bzhi char re bzung nas 'bab bo/ /'dis 'pho chung so so'i mtshams su 'pho chung bcu gcig bzhi cha re rgyu bar 'dod pa ni/ thob skal yin pa ma go bar zad de/ myong ba dang 'gal zhing*/ bu sogs kyang cha bsags nas 'pho chen gyi mtshams su nga drug bzhi cha rgyu bar bzhed pas so/ / gsum pa ni/ g.yas g.yon dkyil 'khor bcu po de'i bdag po'i gza' ni/ nam mkha'i rlung g.yon g.yas kyi sgra dus/ rlung g.yon g.yas zla nyi/ me g.yon g.yas lhag mig g.yon g.yas sangs phur/ sa g.yon g.yas mjug spen| rnams ni pho chung gi zhing bdag tu 'gyur bas/ g.yon g.yas thabs shes yin pa bzhin du/ phyogs dang mtshams thabs shes su byas pas dkyil 'khor gyi gza'i 'god tshul nges pa yang grub bo/ /'pho chen bcu gnyis kyi ni/ lug sogs mi mnyam pa drug la zla ba dang glang sogs mnyam pa drug la nyi ma bdag por gsungs te/

g.yon pa zla ba dang g.yas pa nyi ma'i chos yin pas so/ /rlung rnams kyi byed las ni bshad zin la/ ye shes le'ur rtsa rlung gi zhib cha bshad pa rnams ni dbu ma'i rtsa rlung gi zhib cha yin pas 'og gzhan dang sbyar ba'i gnas tshul gyi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'dir snying kha'i rtsa la rgyu ba'i rlung 'chad pa skabs su bab pa la/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la dang por thun mtshams bzhi 'bab pa'i 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ de nas thun tshod brgyad 'bab pa'i 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ de nas 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'bab pa'i 'dab ma bcu gnyis dang*/ de nas dbyu gu drug cu 'bab pa'i 'dab ma re bzhi rnams gsungs pa ni/ lte ba'i brgyad pa dang snying ga'i brgyad po thun tshod kyi yun tshad 'bab par mtshungs pa shes pa'i ched dang*/ mnyam pa dag la zhes par 'pho mtshams su drug bzhi cha 'bab ste lte ba'i bcu gnyis pa la sbyar ba'i ched yin no/ /'dir snying kha'i rtsa brgyad kyi dbus nas dus me ming can sgra gcan/ g.yon du zla ba dkar po dang g.yas su nyi ma dmar po 'bab ces la g.yon gyi bzhi la zla ba g.yas kyi bzhi la nyi ma'i rtsa 'bab par 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig g.yas sam lho'i dbus ma la dmar ser dang g.yon nam byang gi dbus ma la lug gi ming can gsungs pa la dgongs zhes zer yang mi 'gal te/ lho dang nub kyi bzhi po g.yas dang*/ byang dang shar gyi bzhi po g.yon gyi rtsa rlung du 'dus pas so/ /'dir steng 'og tu srog thur/ shar dang shar lho mnyam gnas dang gyen rgyu/ lho dang lho nub tu khyab byed dang klu dang*/ nub dang nub byang du rus sbal dang rtsangs pa/ byang dang byang shar du lhas sbyin dang nor las rgyal gsungs pa ni/ rlung gi khams dang mi mthun pa ci zhe na/ bu ston rin po che phyogs de dag gi rlung de dag dang por skyes pas skyes khyim lta bu'i dbang gis bzhag pas skyon med de/ dper na/ zla ba rlung khams pa yin kyang lug khyim du skyes pa bzhin zhes gsung ngo*/

/de bzhin rtsa brgyad po la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba la brgyad kyis bgos pa'i nyis stong bdun brgya re rtsa re nas rgyu bar gsungs pas chu tshod phyed dang brgyad du 'gyur la/ de bar ma chad du rtsa re nas rgyu na skyon 'byung bas rtsa g.yon pa nas chu tshod lnga rgya bas rjes su g.yas nas lnga rgyu/ der rting yang g.yon pa nas phyed dang gsum dang g.yas pa nas phyed dang gsum rgyu ba'i tshul gyis rgyu ba yin no zhes kyang gsungs so/ /snga ma'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mnyam gnas la sogs pa rnams kyi skye ba'i gnas te zhes gsungs pas legs shing phyi ma'i rgyu mtshan btsal bar bya'o/ /'og nas rlung rgyu tshul gyi 'grel par/ thun mtshams ye shes kyi rlung de g.yon pa'i 'pho chen gyi mthar byung na sa rlung bzhin du phyi ru sor bcu gnyis rgyu ba dang*/ g.yas pa'i 'pho chen gyi mthar byung na nam mkha'i rlung bzhin du sor bcu drug rgyu bar gsal por gsungs shing*/ mngal sgor thog mar rgyu ba'i ye shes kyi rlung ni/ de rjes de ma thag tu g.yon 'pho 'byung na nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang*/ g.yas 'pho byung na sa rlung dang mthun dgos par shugs yas grub bo/ /'dir nga drug bzhi cha lta bu'i bzhi*/ cha po de 'pho rlung gi sna nas bcad pa'i tshul gyis rgyu'am sbo nas bzhogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyu zhes dwogs pa bslang nas/ rong pa sher seng gnyis ka mi 'thad pas ye shes kyi rlung mi rgyu bar 'dod do/ /mi 'thad de/ 'o na 'pho rlung rnams ye shes kyi rlung nga drug bzhi chas ma tshang bar rgyu'am tshang bar rgyu/ tshang bar rgyu na tshes kyi chad lhag dang zla ba'i cha dang*/ rkang pa'i nor bu lon sogs mi 'thad pa'i rigs pa dang khas blangs pa gnyis ka dang 'gal la/ ma tshang bar rgyu na 'pho rlung 'pho chen re'i stong bdun brgya zhe gsum dang zhe gsum po'i bzhi gsum po de yang bcad bzhogs gnyis ka mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/

tshad dang bcas nas gsungs pa thams cad don med du thal bas gnod pa'i phyir ro// des na sna nas bcad pa'i tshul gyis rgyu bar 'dod do/ /'o na bzhi cha po'i 'phro las rlung gis 'thud nas rgyu'am/ 'phro zad du bcug nas las rlung lte ba nas skye zhe na/ bu ston phyi ma bzhed de/ spyir rlung thams cad kyi tshad khru lnga sor bcu drug par nges te/ lte ba nas snying ga dang de nas mgrin pa dang de nas dpral ba rnams la khru phyed phyed du gsungs shing*/ dpral ba nas gtsug tor dang de nas yang bdun gyi dpral bar log pa'i bar gnyis la sor drug drug ste khru phyed rnams bsdoms pas khru do/ /dpral ba nas sna sgo'i bar la sor brgyad/ sna sgo sa rlung la mtshon na sor bcu gnyis rnams phyir 'byung ba la yod la de bzhin du nang du ldog pa la yod cing*/ chu rlung sogs sna sgor sor res ring yang lte ba nas skye sa sor res mtho bas so/ /de ltar na tshad khru lnga sor bcu drug po'i bzhi cha la khru gang sor bcu yong bas ye shes kyi rlung phyi la lte ba nas smin mtshams kyi thad so tsam du rdzogs te nus pa zad/ de rjes las rlung lte ba nas slar yang skyes te khug pa stong bdun brgya zhe gsum rgyus pa'i mthar rlung bzhi gsum po des phyir rgyus nas nang du log pa na ḍakki ye shes kyi rlung zad pa der zad nas/ slar yang ye shes kyi rlung dbu ma las rgyu ba'i mgo lte ba nas rtsom pa yin no/ /de ltar ma yin par 'phro 'thud pa yin na/ las rlung zad pa'i gnad kyis rlung phyi nas skye ba yod dgos te mi srid pas so zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pa 'di ni mi 'thad de/ ye shes kyi rlung bzhi cha po'i 'phro las rlung gis 'thud phyin chad las rlung bzhi gsum po dpral bar zad don med de lte bar 'gug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'phro 'thud mi nus te/ rlung gnyis rgyu sa'i rtsa rgyun mi gcig pas so/

/zhes brjod na legs so/ /de ltar pha rgyud rlung rgyas par grags shing rdor phreng du rgyas par gsungs kyang 'di lta bu'i rgyas pa ma gsungs pas 'di ma rgyud du 'dod pa rnams la gnod do/ /bzhi pa rtsa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa ni/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi chos rnams nang na rtsa'i rang bzhin du gnas te/ phyi la lo gcig dang de la bgrod pa gnyis dang dus gsum dang bzhi dang zhag don gnyis pa phrag lnga la dbyangs lnga rdzogs par bshad pa ltar dus lnga dang dus drug dang*/ zhag nga gnyis pa bdun dang*/ zhe lnga pa brgyad dang bzhi bcu pa dgu dang so drug pa bcu la sogs pa zhag gi sdes bgrang du yod pa ltar/ ye le'i brgya zhe bzhi pa'i 'grel par rtsa'i dbye ba sde'i sgo nas gsungs so/ /'dir sde ni grangs de nyid kyis bsgyur ba la bya la/ gcig gi sde ni gcig gcig ste dbu ma a wa dhū tī'o// gnyis gnyis bzhi ni gtsug tor dang rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa dang lte ba'i dbus rnams su 'dab ma bzhi pa'o/ /gsum gsum dgu ni/ lte ba'i zlum skor gnyis pa dang*/ snying ga'i 'dab ma brgyad brgyad kyi steng du lte ba'i zlum skor tha ma'am drug pa la gza' bdun gyi skye gnas kyi rtsa bdun bdun yod pa'i zla ba'i skye gnas bsnan pa'o/ /bzhi bzhi bcu drug ni/ dpral ba dang rdo rje dang lte ba'i zlum skor lnga pa zla rkang gi zlum skor rnams la 'dab ma bcu drug pa'o/ /lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ dpral ba'i zlum skor gnyis pa zla rkang gi 'dab ma nyer lnga pa'o/ /drug drug so drug ni/ mgrin pa dang gsang ba'i so gnyis pa gnyis dang*/ lte ba'i mig dmar gza' lag phur bu pa sangs rnams kyi skye gnas so/ /bdun bdun zhe dgu ni/ mgrin pa'i zlum skor gnyis pa la khyim rkang bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang nyi ma'i skye gnas so/ /brgyad brgyad re bzhi ni/ lte ba'i zlum skor bzhi pa dbyu gu'i zlum skor kun la grags pa'o/
